personality_one_liner: A cinematic, exclusive, and high-energy nightlife experience where glassmorphism and deep shadows meet glowing amber and crimson accents.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around elements to create a premium feel. Do not cramp lists or cards.

do's: Bottom sheet headers and drag handles
Event and venue hero cards overlay
dont's: Every single list row in the venue directory

screens.name: Login/Signup
screens.purpose: Onboard users, select roles, and choose membership tiers.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored activity indicator on dark background.
states.error: Toast or inline text using brandSecondary (crimson).

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. The bottom 40% houses a frosted glass container with auth buttons (Apple, Google, Email). Includes a clear hierarchy for Role Selection (Guest, Promoter, Venue) and Membership Tiers using cards with borderStrong for the selected state.

screens.name: Home (Events Feed)
screens.purpose: Discover upcoming nightlife events and parties.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty club with text 'No events near you' and a 'Change Location' CTA.

screens.layout: Glass sticky header for location and filters. Main feed uses large cinematic event cards (2x1 ratio). Each card has a real background photo, a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse), and text/date anchored at the bottom. A pinned FAB for quick map view or filtering.

screens.name: Event Details
screens.purpose: Show event info and drive ticket purchases.
screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image with parallax effect. Glass header with back button. Content (DJs, times, location, promoter info) scrolls over the hero image. A fixed glass bottom container holds the 'Buy Ticket' CTA.

screens.name: Ticket Purchase / Reservation
screens.purpose: Handle transactions including base price, platform fee, and deposits.
screens.layout: Modal bottom sheet. Displays a clear line-item breakdown of costs (Ticket, VIP fee, 15-25% platform fee). Uses brandPrimary for the main payment button.

screens.name: Promoter Dashboard
screens.purpose: Track earnings, view leaderboards, and manage referrals.

states.empty: Prompt to 'Share your first referral link'.

screens.layout: Top section features elevated glass cards showing metrics (Earnings, Tickets Sold) with gold/amber glowing text. Middle section displays a large scannable QR code and share button. Bottom section is a scannable leaderboard list of top promoters.

screens.name: Venue Directory & Profile
screens.purpose: Browse venues and book tables/VIP access.
screens.layout: Directory uses a 2-column grid of venue cards with surfaceSecondary backgrounds and subtle borders. Venue Profile follows the Event Details layout but includes an interactive table/bottle selection form for reservations.

screens.name: QR Check-in
screens.purpose: Admins and promoters scan guest QR codes.
screens.layout: Full screen camera view with a custom overlay and a gold laser scan animation. A bottom glass sheet displays a live feed of recently scanned guests and their status.

screens.name: Profile & Chat
screens.purpose: Manage account, membership, and communicate with venues/promoters.
screens.layout: Profile header with a tinted background indicating membership tier (e.g., gold glow for Premium). Settings options use surfaceSecondary rows with tinted icon containers. Chat list is integrated as a tab or sub-screen with unread badges in brandSecondary.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Glass / Luxe DARK personality strictly: use deep blacks and charcoals as the base, and limit the amber/gold and crimson red to accents and CTAs.
Implement the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (transparent to 80%+ dark surface) on all image-backed cards (Events, Venues) to ensure text readability.
Ensure the primary CTA for reservations and ticketing is sticky at the bottom of scrollable views, encapsulated in a frosted glass container.
Promoter dashboard should prioritize scannability for metrics. Use brandTertiary backgrounds for stat cards to provide a subtle gold tint.
Integrate Phosphor icons with consistent weights across the app. Use filled icons for active tab states and outlined for inactive.
Apply subtle haptic feedback for all major interactions: ticket purchases, tab changes, and QR scans.
Chat should be accessible from the Profile screen or as a header action to save tab space, keeping bottom tabs to Home, Promote, Venues, Profile.
